_comment: JSON has no comments; all _comment* keys are ignored by the runner. Option explanations are listed below.
_comment_no_field: true disables magnetic and beamline fields by removing compact/fields includes.
_comment_seeds: Two deterministic seeds are 42 and 1024. random_seeds=true instead makes all seeds random.
_comment_mc_truth: mc_truth=true preserves secondary-particle parent/daughter relations; it is not the detailed step/trajectory switch.
_comment_keep_all_particles: false is the recommended default: keep the normal MC-truth selection and configured energy/process filters. true retains every Geant4 track, including tracks that did not create a hit, and can greatly increase ROOT/CSV size. It is not needed for detailed shower positions.
_comment_min_kinetic_energy: Only used with mc_truth. 1 MeV is the runner's default threshold; lowering it retains more soft secondaries.
_comment_detailed_shower: true stores calorimeter contribution PDG, step position, and step length; this is needed for step-level motion data.
_comment_converter: auto matches the original runner: it selects root_to_csv_with_particles.py with MC truth, otherwise better_root_to_csv.py.
_comment_contributions: all writes one CSV row per hit contribution; earliest writes only the earliest contribution per hit.
_comment_paths: Relative output paths are rooted at this config file. work_dir defaults to roots_dir/_work.
_comment_jobs: Maximum parallel worker count. The runner caps it to the number of generated jobs, so 100 does not start 100 idle workers.
_comment_runner_extensions: detailed_shower and contributions are generator-runner extensions, not options in the original runner. detailed_shower enables step positions/lengths; contributions selects how the particles converter exports them.
_comment_cli: Explicit command-line options after the SIF path override the corresponding config values.
_comment_portability: Place the config under the current working directory, home, or /tmp for Singularity's default binds. For another location, bind its directory with 'singularity run --bind <dir>:<dir>'; relative output paths resolve from the config directory.
